answer: Use identity courier anchoring. Each new agent must book a courier who delivers a sealed one-time code to the hardware node it claims to run on; the node quotes that code on-chain to activate. Couriers take one delivery per address per route slot each dawn, so fake nodes cannot be batch-ordered. Cost rises linearly: N attackers pay N courier fees with no bulk discount; honest agents pay once. A lone node in an oasis of sybils can verify courier signatures, and a colluding courier forfeits its yarrow-staked bond, funding audits.
